pattern.description: Next step of the vertical option-pill wheel after 'One AI tool to': 'Summarize' rises and blurs out while 'Improve writing' rises from below with motion blur and sharpens into the slot; the pill width adapts to the longer label.
pattern.why_premium: Consistent cadence and identical blur-lift motion across each cycle step build rhythm, and the pill resizing to its label keeps the sentence reading naturally.

build_hint.gsap: Same wheel step as before: tl.to('.pill-stack', {y:'-=pillPitch', duration:0.25, ease:'power2.inOut'}); active pill -> {opacity:1, filter:'blur(0px)'}, neighbours -> {opacity:0.08, filter:'blur(8px)'}; tween pill width to the new label width in parallel.
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config:{damping:200, stiffness:220}}); stack translateY = -(index + p) * pitch; per pill dist = Math.abs(i - (index + p)); opacity = interpolate(dist,[0,1],[1,0.08]); blur = interpolate(dist,[0,1],[0,8]) px.
